question: Modern textbooks usually report the maximum ATP yield from the complete aerobic oxidation of one glucose molecule as:
explanation: Complete oxidation of one glucose yields about 30 to 32 ATP in modern counts, because the measured proton pumping gives fewer ATP per NADH than older ideal estimates assumed.
